primary_source_receipts.finding: Reserve requirement ratios reduced to zero percent effective March 26, 2020, eliminating reserve requirements for all depository institutions.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Does not address capital requirements or the money-multiplier debate.

primary_source_receipts.finding: FOMC raised the federal funds target range to 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Does not itself state a 23-year comparison.

primary_source_receipts.finding: CPI-U rose 9.1% over the year ended June 2022, the largest 12-month increase since the period ending November 1981.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Peak 12-month rate; does not give the annual average.

primary_source_receipts.finding: FDIC founded 1933; no depositor has lost a penny of FDIC-insured funds; $250,000 per depositor, per ownership category, per insured bank.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Does not verify Depression-era failure counts.

primary_source_receipts.limitations: Does not certify an absolute all-time largest-run ranking. PDF sha256 601c32a73e833d3b2a2d6fa5d25a23c56eac85a6fa87558dcd5aa3e30a96f2d6.

primary_source_receipts.finding: Accredited individual: net worth over $1 million excluding primary residence, or income over $200,000 ($300,000 with spouse or partner) in each of the prior two years with the same expected in the current year.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Does not establish fund minimums or industry AUM.
